Method of Attack: Leaking terminal content via DNS requests by performing DNS lookups to check if URLs are valid, which caused sensitive data such as passwords, API keys, and usernames to be sent in cleartext DNS requests
Hovering mouse over terminal content triggered DNS requests to validate URLs, unintentionally leaking sensitive information
Attack Vector: DNS requests triggered by mouse hover over terminal content
Date of Discovery: Ten months before the fix release (around late 2019 or early 2020)
